interactions.name: Primary input
interactions.trigger: Pointer activation of the demonstrated primary control
interactions.response: The product advances from the entry surface into the task
interactions.cancellation: Move away without activating the control
interactions.failure: No activation leaves the entry state unchanged
interactions.recovery: Return to the visible control and activate it

interactions.name: Focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Select the demonstrated item, field, or workspace target
interactions.response: The target becomes the active context
interactions.feedback: Selection styling or an active detail surface is visible
interactions.failure: An unselected target does not advance the workflow

interactions.name: Navigation
interactions.response: The central product surface changes while application context remains
interactions.feedback: Destination content replaces the prior surface
interactions.failure: A wrong destination shows content unrelated to the goal
interactions.recovery: Navigate back to the demonstrated destination

interactions.name: Configuration
interactions.trigger: Enter or choose the demonstrated task parameters
interactions.response: The product reflects the configured values
interactions.feedback: The in-progress state exposes the chosen configuration
interactions.cancellation: Remove or replace the current choice
interactions.failure: An incomplete configuration cannot produce the shown result

interactions.name: Confirmation
interactions.trigger: Activate the demonstrated commit, create, run, send, or save action
interactions.feedback: The surface transitions toward the result
interactions.cancellation: Back out before the commit action
interactions.failure: Committing with the task incomplete leaves a no-result state
interactions.recovery: Complete the required context and confirm again

interactions.name: Backtracking
interactions.trigger: Return from the current detail or configuration surface
interactions.response: The previous product context is restored
interactions.failure: Leaving too early abandons the pending result
interactions.recovery: Re-enter the demonstrated task from the restored context

interactions.name: System feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after the demonstrated committed action
interactions.response: The first meaningful result becomes visible
interactions.feedback: Result content replaces or augments the in-progress state
interactions.cancellation: No cancellation is shown after completion
interactions.failure: Stopping before feedback provides no completion evidence
interactions.recovery: Wait for the visible result state

interactions.name: Failure and recovery
interactions.trigger: Attempt to proceed without the demonstrated selection or context
interactions.response: The workflow remains incomplete rather than reaching the result
interactions.feedback: The expected result state is absent
interactions.cancellation: Return to the preceding stable surface
interactions.recovery: Restore the demonstrated context and repeat the confirmed action

motion_analysis.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: a 90.12s screen recording of the Xero web app that plays itself. Inside it the pointer moves on its own — it climbs to the Purchases nav item by ~13.5s and the menu opens at 14.0s, it hovers "Expenses" by 15.5s, and it reaches the claim row's overflow control at 72.0s.
motion_analysis.start_state: Grey "Xero Expenses" title card carrying the bullet "Capture costs as they happen" alone at 0s, with a second bullet "Keep track of your spending" present by 6s (media/motion.mp4 0-9.5s).
motion_analysis.end_state: Expenses > To pay list reading "To pay 267.02" with a blue "Pay all · 267.02" button and the two claim rows, held to the last sampled frame at 89.5s.
motion_analysis.continuity: One 90.12s recording at 25 fps (2251 frames). The title card cross-dissolves into the Foxglove Studios business overview between 10.0s and 11.0s — at 10.5s both images are visible in the same frame — and from 11.0s onward it is continuous live UI with a travelling pointer and no further dissolves. Teal ellipses drawn over the recording annotate the file-upload target at ~30s, the Optional block at 45s and the sub-nav tabs at 78-81s.
motion_analysis.interruption_or_reversal: The Filter panel opened over the To pay list at ~83.0s is dismissed at ~85.5s without applying a filter: the list is identical before and after (same two rows, "To pay 267.02") and the blue "Pay all · 267.02" button becomes visible again (media/motion.mp4 83.0-85.5s).
motion_analysis.feedback: Each committed action redraws numbers in the same frame: submitting the expense claim puts 243.92 under "Submitted" by 54s, adding the 33 mi mileage claim raises "To be paid" from 0.00 to 23.10 by 66s, and choosing "Approve" from the row overflow menu between 73.0s and 75.0s flips "Submitted" 243.92 to 0.00 and "To be paid" 23.10 to 267.02 by 75.5s while the sub-nav counts settle at "To review 0 / To pay 2".

observations: The Purchases dropdown names every destination in text — "Purchases overview", "Bills", "Purchase orders", "Expenses", "Suppliers", "Purchases settings" — with no icon-only entries (media/state-01-entry.jpg, 14.4s).

Counts are carried as numerals beside their labels rather than by motion: the sub-nav reads "To review 0" and "To pay 2" and the group header reads "To be paid 2" (media/state-03-result.jpg), while the overview tiles spell out "20 items to reconcile", "6 Overdue invoices" and "3 Overdue bills" (media/state-01-entry.jpg).

The active section is marked twice over: in the tab strip of media/state-03-result.jpg (y 28-52) "Your own" is drawn in blue and underlined while "To review", "To pay", "All" and "Explorer" stay dark grey, so the current tab is not signalled by colour alone.

In media/state-03-result.jpg the claim-row title crop (x 88-222, y 181-193) measures a 10.26:1 luminance contrast ratio between its brightest 2% of pixels (255,255,255) and its darkest 2% (65,64,70), and the summary-band crop holding "To be paid 267.02" (x 392-470, y 110-142) measures 9.65:1 for (57,60,65) against (236,240,241). Both computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula over the retained JPEG.

The teal ellipses that ring the upload target at ~30s, the Optional block at 45s and the sub-nav tabs at 78-81s are drawn on top of the recording rather than rendered by the product, so no native focus indicator is observable anywhere in the clip.
State stays legible with the animation stopped: organisation name, claim descriptions, dates, the account code "420 - Entertainment" and every amount are text in the retained frames.
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, and live-region announcements were not exposed by the static-source recording.
Complete keyboard traversal and focus order were not established by the recording.
Reduced-motion preference handling and a nonanimated equivalent were not demonstrated.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
